long_biography.plain_text:
Taking sole ownership of Duna Aszfalt gave László Szíjj direct control of the construction platform he had built with childhood friend Károly Varga. Its capabilities now span roads and bridges, utilities, water infrastructure, asphalt production, quarries and technical facilities. This integrated model lets operating companies support complex civil-engineering projects with materials, equipment and specialist knowledge from within the group.

Szíjj trained in engineering at the University of Pécs and had considered independent contracting since the mid-1980s. His first company's papers were submitted in 1989, while Duna Aszfalt began operating in 1996.
